current.service_desc:
Google Workspace (formerly G Suite) is comprised of Google’s multi-tenant public and hybrid cloud instances and leverages Google Services.

** The entire authorized security boundary of Google Services is documented, assessed, and managed against the FedRAMP High baseline of security and privacy controls. Services that are denoted with an asterisk (*) do not meet the SA-9(5) requirement. Please review the JAB P-ATO letter for more information.

used_by.use: Google Workspace — provider identity (Cloud Identity) for staff access to production through Identity-Aware Proxy, with security-key or passkey 2-Step Verification enforced for all staff; staff email including the FedRAMP Security Inbox. No customer data.
Google Workspace. Suite of enterprise productivity, collaboration, and communication tools, and the workforce identity and access management provider supplying single sign-on to in-scope systems.
Google Workspace. Single sign-on (SSO) and authentication provider for in-scope systems.
Google Workspace: Email for Optimal staff and for alert notification; not an identity provider to the boundary
Identity provider for CLEATUS staff, with enforced multi-factor authentication, and staff email and documents.
Employee identity and single sign-on for administrative access to production systems.
Google Workspace (High, JAB authorized). Corporate productivity, email, and collaboration suite.
Email, calendar, and internal document collaboration for OpenClinica staff.
Google Workspace: corporate email, including the FedRAMP Security Inbox; no federal customer data.
Google Workspace provides FedRAMP-authorized workspace services for CSP staff support and business communications related to the CSO.
Corporate identity, email, and collaboration services supporting Dispel personnel who operate and administer the DZTE service.
Google Workspace provides the internal documentation repository for ATX Defense CMMC Space developers and administrators.
